name: Jin's Test Visual Novel
source:
This is a test build of a visual novel made by me, Jin.
Play this game to get to know me and perhaps have a laugh or two!

[From [url=https://jinzhi.itch.io/jins-test-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是由我（Jin）亲手制作的一款视觉小说测试版。
欢迎游玩本作来认识一下我，顺便博君一笑！

[摘自[url=https://jinzhi.itch.io/jins-test-visual-novel]itch.io[/url]]
